spectral_product_broadband.description: Single material-light spectral product under broadband illumination, corresponding to the paper's one-bounce codec proxy and two-pass k=6 rendering claim.

mean_delta_e94.description: Average perceptual color error over the slice.

median_delta_e94.description: Typical perceptual color error, less sensitive to a few outliers.

p95_delta_e94.description: Near-worst-case perceptual color error that catches methods tuned only for the mean.

worst_decile_delta_e94.description: Mean perceptual color error on the hardest ten percent of cases in the slice.

spectral_mse.description: Mean squared wavelength-space error for methods that emit spectra.

render_passes.description: Declared number of rendering passes, preserving the paper's compact-rendering constraint.

latent_channels.description: Declared latent channel count, preserving the compact-code constraint.

output_wavelengths.description: Number of output channels inferred from predictions, distinguishing spectral output from tristimulus output.

spectral_product_narrowband.description: Single material-light spectral product under narrowband illumination, the difficult case where the paper reports visible RGB color shifts and improved k=6 latent rendering.

mean_delta_e94.description: Average perceptual color error under spiky illumination.

median_delta_e94.description: Typical perceptual color error under spiky illumination.

p95_delta_e94.description: Near-worst-case narrowband color error that catches brittle spectral encodings.

worst_decile_delta_e94.description: Mean color error on the hardest ten percent of narrowband cases.

spectral_mse.description: Mean squared wavelength-space error for spectral predictions.

render_passes.description: Declared number of rendering passes, preserving the paper's compact-rendering constraint.

latent_channels.description: Declared latent channel count, preserving the compact-code constraint.

output_wavelengths.description: Number of output channels inferred from predictions, distinguishing spectral output from tristimulus output.

multibounce_narrowband.description: Three-bounce narrowband multiplicative chain, corresponding to the paper's multibounce stability test and supplemental narrowband MSE report.

mean_delta_e94.description: Average perceptual color error after repeated interactions.

median_delta_e94.description: Typical perceptual color error after repeated interactions.

p95_delta_e94.description: Near-worst-case multibounce color error that catches accumulated failures.

worst_decile_delta_e94.description: Mean color error on the hardest ten percent of multibounce cases.

spectral_mse.description: Mean squared wavelength-space error after three multiplicative interactions.
